text: I will remember my covenant
theme: the bow in the cloud, a sign of the covenant
kjv: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

text: In you and in your offspring
theme: a ladder set up between earth and heaven
kjv: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

text: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang…
theme: song at the sea
kjv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

text: stood at the door of the Tent
theme: face to face, as one speaks to a friend
kjv: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD talked with Moses.

text: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up
theme: the cloud filling the tabernacle
kjv: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

text: and I will bless them
theme: the blessing put on the people
kjv: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

text: and underground water flowing into valleys and hills
theme: a good land, brooks and springs
kjv: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

text: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart
theme: gathered again and brought home
kjv: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

text: and to return from following you
theme: your people will be my people
kjv: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

text: because he loved him as his own soul
theme: the soul of Jonathan knit to David
kjv: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

text: They both made a covenant before Yahweh
theme: Jonathan strengthens David's hand in God
kjv: And they two made a covenant before the LORD: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

text: After the earthquake a fire passed
theme: a still small voice after the fire
kjv: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

text: please open his eyes
theme: the mountain full of horses and fire
kjv: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

text: for the joy of Yahweh is your strength
theme: the joy of the LORD is your strength
kjv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

text: For everything there is a season
theme: a time for everything
kjv: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

text: if two lie together
theme: two are better than one
kjv: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?

text: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz…
theme: swords into plowshares
kjv: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

text: Each one had six wings
theme: the whole earth is full of his glory
kjv: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

text: as men rejoice when they divide the plunder
theme: the people who walked in darkness
kjv: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

text: a feast of choice wines
theme: he will swallow up death forever
kjv: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

text: In that day, this song will be sung…
theme: a strong city, salvation for walls
kjv: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.

text: like the light of seven days
theme: the LORD waits to be gracious
kjv: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

text: ” says your God
theme: the word of our God stands forever
kjv: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

text: who makes a way in the sea
theme: I am making a way in the desert
kjv: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

text: Yahweh says:…
theme: like a tree planted by the waters
kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.

text: to give you hope and a future
theme: plans for peace, to give you hope
kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

text: Yahweh appeared of old to me
theme: I have loved you with everlasting love
kjv: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

text: I will sprinkle clean water on you
theme: a new heart and a new spirit
kjv: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

text: Then the bones came together
theme: the valley of dry bones, and breath
kjv: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

text: on my stringed instruments
theme: yet I will rejoice in the LORD
kjv: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

text: He will rejoice over you with singing
theme: he will rejoice over you with singing
kjv: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

text: Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth
theme: I will bring them back, and they will dwell
kjv: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.

text: You shall tread down the wicked
theme: the sun of righteousness will rise
kjv: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the LORD of hosts.

text: Neither do you light a lamp
theme: the light of the world, a city on a hill
kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

text: Isn’t life more than food
theme: consider the lilies of the field
kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

text: Lord of heaven and earth
theme: my yoke is easy, my burden light
kjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

text: His appearance was like lightning
theme: he is not here, he has risen
kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

text: It’s like a grain of mustard seed
theme: the seed growing by itself
kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

text: After six days Jesus took with him Peter
theme: his garments became glistening white
kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

text: Mary said,…
theme: my soul magnifies the Lord
kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

text: They came with haste
theme: good news of great joy
kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

text: Bring the fattened calf
theme: this my son was dead and is alive
kjv: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

text: They remembered his words
theme: why do you seek the living among the dead
kjv: And they remembered his words,

text: In him was life
theme: the light shines in the darkness
kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

text: but will have the light of life
theme: I am the light of the world
kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

text: Therefore the Father loves me
theme: I came that they may have life
kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

text: Now Jesus loved Martha
theme: I am the resurrection and the life
kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

text: He who loves his life will lose it
theme: unless a grain of wheat falls
kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

text: In my Father’s house are many homes
theme: in my Father's house are many rooms
kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

text: Even as the Father has loved me
theme: I have called you friends
kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

text: for the Father himself loves you
theme: in me you may have peace
kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

text: They both ran together
theme: the stone taken away from the tomb
kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

text: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews
theme: I will pour out my Spirit
kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

text: He called for lights
theme: believing in God with his household
kjv: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

text: we will be saved by his life
theme: hope does not disappoint
kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

text: For we were saved in hope
theme: nothing will separate us from his love
kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

text: be at peace with all men
theme: overcome evil with good
kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

text: Therefore accept one another
theme: the God of hope fill you with joy
kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

text: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness
theme: faith, hope and love remain
kjv: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;

text: But thanks be to God
theme: death is swallowed up in victory
kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: which is for the moment
theme: momentary affliction, eternal weight of glory
kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ
theme: new creation, the old has passed
kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love
theme: the fruit of the Spirit is love
kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

text: For he is our peace
theme: he is our peace, who made us one
kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

text: There is one body and one Spirit
theme: one body and one Spirit
kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness
theme: he who began a good work
kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

text: And the peace of God
theme: rejoice in the Lord always
kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

text: bearing with one another
theme: love, which is the bond of perfection
kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

text: Therefore comfort one another with these words
theme: we will be caught up together
kjv: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself
theme: comfort your hearts
kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for
theme: faith is assurance of things hoped for
kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

text: the author and perfecter of faith
theme: a cloud of witnesses surrounding us
kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

text: For we don’t have here an enduring city
theme: do not forget to do good
kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

text: coming down from the Father of lights
theme: every good gift comes down from above
kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

text: Wherein you greatly rejoice
theme: a living hope through the resurrection
kjv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

text: Withstand him steadfast in your faith
theme: the God of all grace restore you
kjv: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

text: even as our beloved brother Paul also
theme: new heavens and a new earth
kjv: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

text: we have fellowship with one another
theme: God is light, and in him no darkness
kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

text: even as he is pure
theme: we will be like him
kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

text: If we love one another
theme: God is love, and we ought to love
kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

text: with palm branches in their hands
theme: he will wipe away every tear
kjv: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

text: I saw the holy city
theme: a new heaven and a new earth
kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

text: The nations will walk in its light
theme: the river of water of life
kjv: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

text: in the middle of its street
theme: no more night, they will reign forever
kjv: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
